learning.en: But you will lose out on all of the other parts of language learning.
learning.zh: 但你会失去语言学习的所有其他部分。

learning.en: Bye for now. Goodbye! Thanks for listening to this podcast from BBC Learning English.
learning.zh: 先这样。再见！谢谢收听BBC学英语的这个播客。

learning.en: Children seem to be better at learning things like pronunciation and those grammar aspects.
learning.zh: 孩子们似乎更擅长学习发音和那些语法方面的东西。

learning.en: This is why communicative and task-based approaches to learning English have become really popular.
learning.zh: 这就是为什么以交际和任务为基础的英语学习方法变得非常受欢迎的原因。

learning.en: And am I learning from those mistakes? Or is my current learning method effective?
learning.zh: 我是否在从这些错误中吸取教训？或者我目前的学习方法是否有效？

learned.en: Fourth, language learned in a meaningful situation becomes permanent or at least lasts longer.
learned.zh: 第四，在有意义的情境中学习的语言会变成永久记忆，或者至少能持续更长时间。

learned.en: OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with migrate: move to a different place.
learned.zh: 好，我们来回顾一下学到的词汇，先从 migrate(迁徙)开始：指转移到另一个地方。

learned.en: Let’s take a look at what I learned last year and what’s coming next.
learned.zh: 让我们来看看我去年学到了什么，以及接下来会发生什么。

learned.en: And you were correct. Yay! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned in this episode.
learned.zh: 你答对了。太好了！好了。让我们回顾一下本期节目中学习的词汇。

learned.en: I think I did one last year about what I’ve learned from living abroad.
learned.zh: 我想我去年做过一期关于海外生活感悟的节目。

length.en: Importantly, this was always at an arm's length from the official government.
length.zh: 重要的是，这一切始终与官方政府保持着距离。

length.en: Or to put it another way, the length of “a year”.
length.zh: 换句话说，就是“一年”的长度。

length.en: Well, actually, the answer was c) his first full length film, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, was not a failure.
length.zh: 嗯，其实答案是 c)：他的第一部长篇电影《白雪公主与七个小矮人》并没有失败。

length.en: The Julian calendar, as it came to be known, was based on the solar year, with a length of 365.25 days.
length.zh: 后来被称为儒略历的日历是以太阳年为基础的，长度为 365.25 天。

length.en: It can also mean an agreed length of time in which someone can change their mind about something they’ve agreed to buy.
length.zh: 它也可以指某人可以改变他们同意购买某物的主意的商定时间长度。

level.en: This is probably the reason why my Japanese is still at a decent level.
level.zh: 这可能就是我的日语至今仍保持在不错水平的原因。

level.en: They do things like apologizing for their language level or hesitating before every sentence.
level.zh: 他们会做一些诸如为自己的语言水平道歉，或者在每个句子前犹豫不决的事情。

level.en: But find something just slightly above your level, something that forces you to grow.
level.zh: 但要找到略高于你水平的东西，能迫使你成长的事物。

level.en: But once you reach a certain level of comfort, the effect flattens out.
level.zh: 但一旦你达到了某个舒适的水平，这种边际效应就会趋于平缓。

level.en: If something touches your soul, it affects you deeply on an emotional or spiritual level.
level.zh: 如果某事触动了你的灵魂，它会在情感或精神层面上深刻地影响你。

leather.en: Well, strangely enough, it all comes down to leather gloves.
leather.zh: 说来奇怪，这一切都归结于皮手套。

leather.en: Well, I really enjoy the smell of leather, but something I really love is the smell of rain, which has a name.
leather.zh: 我挺喜欢皮革的味道，不过我真正钟爱的是雨的气味，而这种气味其实是有专门名字的。

leather.en: Lisa Lee is a toy maker based in Vancouver and the owner of Leather Monsters, a brand of leather plushies which she advertises online.
leather.zh: Lisa Lee是一位居住在温哥华的玩具制造商，也是皮革毛绒玩具品牌Leather Monsters的创始人，她在网上宣传自己的品牌。

leather.en: Lisa Lee is a toy maker based in Vancouver and the owner of Leather Monsters, a brand of leather plushies which she advertises online.
leather.zh: Lisa Lee是一位居住在温哥华的玩具制造商，也是皮革毛绒玩具品牌Leather Monsters的创始人，她在网上宣传自己的品牌。

leather.en: As a child, this boy would often visit his father’s military camps dressed in a tiny soldier’s outfit, complete with little leather boots.
leather.zh: 小时候，这个男孩经常穿着一套迷你士兵制服参观他父亲的军营，脚上还穿着可爱的小皮靴。

least.en: The proposal is specifically about this middle tier of offences, for now at least.
least.zh: 这项提案针对的，至少目前来说，是这类处于中间层级的罪行。

least.en: So…what did happen, or at least what are some theories about what happened?
least.zh: 那么……究竟发生了什么，或者说，关于发生了什么，又有哪些猜测呢？

least.en: In other words, US citizens can do it, according to US law at least.
least.zh: 换句话说，至少根据美国法律，美国公民可以这么做。

least.en: Fourth, language learned in a meaningful situation becomes permanent or at least lasts longer.
least.zh: 第四，在有意义的情境中学习的语言会变成永久记忆，或者至少能持续更长时间。

least.en: Under Putin, the economy stabilised, and living standards improved, at least in the early years.
least.zh: 在普京的领导下，经济趋于稳定，生活水平有所提高，至少在早期是这样的。

leader.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
leader.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

leader.en: Leaders came and went. Power often changed hands through violence rather than elections.
leader.zh: 领导人走马灯似地换。权力往往通过暴力而非选举易手。

leader.en: And the city hosted royal ceremonies, diplomatic events if other countries’ leaders came to visit.
leader.zh: 这座城市还举办了皇家典礼，以及其他国家领导人来访时的外交活动。

leader.en: And Ali Soilih, well he is an unconventional leader in almost every sense.
leader.zh: 至于 Ali Soilih，嗯，在几乎所有意义上，他都是一位极不寻常的领导人。

leader.en: Legend suggests that leader of these settlers was Byzas, who named the city after himself.
leader.zh: 传说这些定居者的首领是拜扎斯，他用自己的名字给这座城市命名。

leading.en: In everyday conversation, leading questions can limit an honest discussion and they can damage trust.
leading.zh: 在日常对话中，引导性问题会限制坦诚的讨论，并会破坏信任。

leading.en: Leading questions are the most common example.
leading.zh: 引导性问题就是最典型的例子。

leading.en: In countries without strong or universal healthcare, like the USA, medical costs are one of the leading causes of financial hardship.
leading.zh: 在没有健全或全民医保的国家（如美国），医疗费用是导致经济困难的主要原因之一。

leading.en: In 1914, she helped found the Radium Institute in Paris, which became a leading center for research in physics and chemistry and medicine.
leading.zh: 1914 年，她协助在巴黎创立了镭研究所，该研究所后来成为物理学、化学和医学研究的顶尖中心。

leading.en: According to this idea, the island’s forests were destroyed to move the Moai, leading to soil erosion, food shortages, and eventually social breakdown.
leading.zh: 根据这种观点，岛上的森林为了搬运 Moai 被砍伐殆尽，导致了水土流失、粮食短缺，最终引发了社会崩溃。

legend.en: And according to legend, the mermaid was supposed to protect the people of Warsaw.
legend.zh: 根据传说，人鱼理应保护华沙的人民。

legend.en: Legend suggests that leader of these settlers was Byzas, who named the city after himself.
legend.zh: 传说这些定居者的首领是拜扎斯，他用自己的名字给这座城市命名。

legend.en: Stories like this give us a chance right now to talk about myths, legends, and folklore.
legend.zh: 像这样的故事正好让我们有机会聊聊神话、传说和民间故事。

legend.en: According to their own legends, they came from a distant, possibly mythical homeland called Aztlán.
legend.zh: 根据他们自己的传说，他们来自一个遥远、甚至可能是神话中的故乡，名叫阿兹特兰。

legend.en: There is also a famous legend about how Singapore got its name.
legend.zh: 关于新加坡名字的由来还有一个著名的传说。

lean.en: Hitler was standing in the middle, leaning over a map placed on the table.
lean.zh: 希特勒正站在中央，俯身看着桌上的一张地图。

lean.en: If Hitler hadn’t been leaning over the table, it would almost certainly have killed him.
lean.zh: 如果希特勒当时没有俯身看地图，几乎肯定能炸死他。

lean.en: We also heard that people who have a regular breakfast are leaner.
lean.zh: 我们还听到经常吃早餐的人更瘦。

lean.en: And one of the reasons given why people might be leaner is that they have better appetite control.
lean.zh: 人们更瘦的原因之一是他们有更好的食欲控制。

lean.en: After each successful act of violence, Punch leans forward and shouts his catchphrase to the audience through the swazzle: "That's the way to do it!"
lean.zh: 在每一次成功的暴力行过后，Punch 都会前倾身体，通过 swazzle 向观众大喊他的口号：“That's the way to do it!（这就对了！）”

leaf.en: But let’s say that Bill leaves the regular army and joins a company like Blackwater.
leaf.zh: 但假设比尔离开了正规军，加入了一家像黑水公司这样的公司。

leaf.en: Tauros eat everything from grass and leaves to tree branches and bark, each consuming over 30 kilos a day.
leaf.zh: 原牛几乎什么都吃，从青草、树叶到树枝、树皮，每头牛每天要吃掉 30 多公斤。

leaf.en: If the UAE leaves OPEC successfully and benefits economically, maybe other countries will decide to do the same in the future.​
leaf.zh: 如果阿联酋成功退出OPEC并在经济上受益，也许其他国家未来也会效仿。

leaf.en: Later came the friction method: spinning a dry wooden rod against a flat piece of softer wood until there's enough heat built up to set dry leaves or wood alight.
leaf.zh: 后来出现了摩擦法：将一根干燥的木棍对着一块较软的干木头旋转，直到积聚足够的热量来点燃干树叶或木头。

leaf.en: First, it's thought it was through percussion, striking pieces of flint against iron pyrite to create sparks that could catch in a small bundle of tinder: small, dry pieces of wood or leaves.
leaf.zh: 首先，人们认为是通过打击乐般的方法，用燧石敲击黄铁矿产生火花，这些火花可以点燃一小捆火绒：细小、干燥的木头或树叶。

lengthen.en: Wow, so a good night's sleep can lengthen your life.
lengthen.zh: 哇，所以睡个好觉能延长寿命。

legitimate.en: Legitimate governments rule because people agreed to be governed.
legitimate.zh: 合法的政府进行统治是因为人民同意被统治。

legitimate.en: Morsi dug his heels, insisting he was the legitimate president, elected by the people, which of course, technically he was.
legitimate.zh: Morsi 固执己见，坚称自己是合法总统，由人民选出，当然从技术上讲他确实是。

legitimate.en: Everything about the physical environment communicated one message: this is a legitimate scientific enterprise conducted by experts who know exactly what they are doing.
legitimate.zh: 整个物理环境所传达的信息只有一个：这是一项正规的科学研究，由清楚自己在做什么的专家主持。

leap.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on the science of leap years.
leap.zh: 好了，今天的关于闰年科学的节目就到这里。

leap.en: So, to wrap things up, today, we hardly need to think about leap years.
leap.zh: 所以，总而言之，今天我们几乎不需要考虑闰年。

leap.en: Different cultures around the world made this leap, this jump, independently without copying each other.
leap.zh: 世界各地的不同文化在没有互相抄袭的情况下，各自独立地实现了这一飞跃。

leap.en: Writing is where AI has perhaps made the biggest leap forward for English learners, and where I think the benefits are most clear-cut.
leap.zh: 在写作方面，人工智能可能为英语学习者迈出了最大的一步，而且我认为其好处也最为明确。

leap.en: So at some point in the eighteenth century, Punch made the leap from one form to the other, from marionette to glove puppet.
leap.zh: 所以在十八世纪的某个时候，Punch 完成了从一种形式到另一种形式的跨越，从提线木偶变成了手套木偶。

leopard.en: And in a world where leopards, lions, hyenas, and sabre-toothed cats were a constant menace, especially in the darkness of night, fire was a wonderful deterrent.
leopard.zh: 在一个豹子、狮子、鬣猫和剑齿虎构成持续威胁的世界里，特别是在黑夜中，火是一个极好的威慑力量。

legal.en: In fact, I didn’t really even know the legal definition of car in Japanese.
legal.zh: 事实上，我甚至不知道日语中“汽车”的法律定义是什么。

legal.en: While it is legal in the USA, it raises questions about fairness and democracy.
legal.zh: 虽然它在美国是合法的，但它引发了关于公平和民主的问题。

legal.en: And what followed was not due legal process, it was revenge, pure and simple.
legal.zh: 接下来发生的事，不是什么正当的法律程序，而是彻头彻尾的复仇。

legal.en: It no longer needed to rely on Britain. Full legal independence, however, came gradually.
legal.zh: 它不再需要依赖英国。然而，完全的法律独立是一个渐进的过程。

legal.en: The people who had always farmed that land suddenly had no legal claim to it.
legal.zh: 那些世世代代耕种那片土地的人突然间在法律上失去了对土地的所有权。

leadership.en: Prussia developed a reputation for strict organization and strong leadership and a military culture.
leadership.zh: 普鲁士以严明的组织、强大的领导力和军事文化而闻名。

leadership.en: The hard part was done. Adolf Hitler was dead, and a bunch of his senior leadership too.
leadership.zh: 最困难的部分已经完成了。阿道夫·希特勒死了，他的一帮高层领导也死了。

leadership.en: Under his leadership, his political party, the People’s Action Party, became the dominant political force in Singapore.
leadership.zh: 在他的领导下，他的政党——人民行动党，成为了新加坡占主导地位的政治力量。

leadership.en: At the same time, the East German leadership was struggling.
leadership.zh: 与此同时，东德领导层陷入了困境。

leadership.en: Are frequent changes in leadership healthy for a democracy?
leadership.zh: 频繁更换领袖对民主制度是健康的吗？

leak.en: People worried about radiation leaks, accidents, and the long-term effects of nuclear waste.
leak.zh: 人们担心辐射泄漏、事故以及核废料的长期影响。

leak.en: He admits leaking the documents. The judge, summing up, tells the jury that "the interests of the state" are the same as the interests of the government, and directs them accordingly.
leak.zh: 他承认泄露了文件。法官在总结陈词时告诉陪审团，"国家利益"等同于政府利益，并据此对陪审团做出相应指示。

leak.en: He has leaked classified documents to a Labour Member of Parliament — documents that revealed the Argentine Navy ship General Belgrano had been sailing away from the British exclusion zone when it was sunk during the Falklands War, killing 323 Argentine sailors.
leak.zh: 他向一位工党下议院议员泄露了机密文件——这些文件揭示出，阿根廷海军的"贝尔格拉诺将军号"(General Belgrano)在福克兰战争中被击沉时，其实正驶离英国划定的禁区，这次击沉事件造成323名阿根廷海员丧生。

lest.en: And, lest we forget, there’s the branding.
lest.zh: 而且，我们千万不要忘记，还有品牌效应。

lest.en: He is too old and weak to get up, and Odysseus knows that he cannot greet him, lest his identity be revealed.
lest.zh: 它太老弱了，已经站不起来了，奥德修斯也知道自己不能上前打招呼，以免暴露身份。

lest.en: As I’m sure you know, there are podcasts about everything: comedy, TV shows, business, football, knitting, fishing, obscure historical periods, and, lest I forget, podcasts that help you learn a language.
lest.zh: 相信大家都知道，播客的主题无所不包：喜剧、电视节目、商业、足球、编织、钓鱼、冷门的历史时期，当然，还有帮助你学习语言的播客。

legislation.en: But crucially, it cannot block legislation indefinitely, forever.
legislation.zh: 但至关重要的是，它不能无限期地阻止立法。

legislation.en: This even came down to legislation around clothing.
legislation.zh: 这甚至延伸到了关于服装的立法。

legislation.en: As of the time of writing this, she has cast 33 tie-breaking votes, making her the most influential VP in American history from a Senate legislation point of view at least.
legislation.zh: 截至本文撰写之时，她已经投下了33次打破僵局的关键票，至少从参议院立法的角度来看，这使她成为美国历史上最具影响力的副总统。

legacy.en: Will Putin’s legacy be that of a man who restored Russia’s pride and power?
legacy.zh: 普京留下的政治遗产，会是一个恢复了俄罗斯尊严和力量的人吗？

legacy.en: Can we really call him a scientist? And does his legacy still matter today, more than 500 years after his death?
legacy.zh: 我们真的能称他为科学家吗？在他逝世五百多年后的今天，他的遗产是否依然重要？

legacy.en: Hardy, his remarkable discoveries, his legacy, and finally, we’ll reflect on the role of mathematics itself in the world of science.
legacy.zh: Hardy、他卓越的发现、他的遗产，最后，我们将反思数学本身在科学世界中的角色。

legacy.en: In this episode, we’ll explore her life, achievements, struggles, and lasting legacy of one of the most influential scientists of all time.
legacy.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将探讨这位有史以来最具影响力的科学家之一的一生、成就、奋斗历程以及她留下的不朽遗产。

legacy.en: Perhaps the main evidence of Leonardo da Vinci’s legacy is that around the world almost everyone has heard of the great painter Leonardo da Vinci.
legacy.zh: 或许列奥纳多·达·芬奇遗产的主要证明是，世界各地几乎所有人都听说过伟大的画家列奥纳多·达·芬奇。

lease.en: Most of the island’s land was leased to foreign companies, mainly for sheep farming.
lease.zh: 岛上的大部分土地被租给外国公司，主要用于养羊。

lecture.en: I’ve sat in university lectures and business meetings where someone asks a question, and halfway through that question, everyone in the room is already confused or bored or frustrated.
lecture.zh: 我曾坐在大学阶梯教室和商务会议中，听到有人提出一个问题，结果问题还没问到一半，屋里的每个人就已经感到困惑、无聊或沮丧了。
